subject: Recon: Cloudline Apr 2024 retroactive capacity true-up & settlement
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudline.ai>; Procurement Team <procurement@cloudline.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Apr 2024 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Usage reconciliation: Mar 2024 retroactive capacity true-up

Hi Samira / Procurement team,

Hope you're doing well — quick note from our side after we ran the monthly ingestion of account usage. Cloudline exceeded the committed Dedicated capacity for March by ~142k inference units (prefix-cached tokens + peak bursts). Because your contract includes a post-term true-up clause, we need to reconcile that delta and agree next steps for one-time settlement or capacity top-up.

What I can share now:
- Snapshot from Redwood billing: March 2024 peak: 1.35M tokens, committed: 1.21M tokens (142k over).
- Proposed one-time settlement (at committed overage rate): $5,680 USD.

Could you confirm whether Cloudline wants (A) an invoice for the one-time overage, (B) to convert the excess into a short-term top-up add-on this quarter, or (C) dispute and provide a counter-usage file? If you choose (A) we can issue the invoice and accept PO# on your side; if (B) we can roll it into April capacity with a proration.

I've cc'd Soojin from Renewals to help with the options and Marissa from Finance in case you want a line-item breakdown. If easier, we can hop on a quick 20-min call this week.

Thanks,

--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

Attachment: (none)
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudline.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cloudline.ai>; Ethan Park <ethan.park@cloudline.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2024 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage reconciliation: Mar 2024 retroactive capacity true-up

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for flagging this. We had a burst during the integration testing window (Mar 21–23) that may have driven the spike; attaching our internal export for March (see cloudline_usage_report_Mar2024.csv). Can you confirm what windows Redwood used for the snapshot (UTC vs. PST) and whether prefix cache hits were included? That will help us reconcile.

At a high level we prefer option (B) — folding part of the overage into a one‑month top-up if the numbers check out; otherwise we'll accept an invoice if it's above our disputable threshold. We need a formal line-item breakdown for procurement and the PO team.

Appreciate it — I'll aim to get PO guidance from our procurement folks once we see the breakdown.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Operations, Cloudline Analytics
samira.k@cloudline.ai

Looping Marissa from Billing — Samira sent a CSV with their internal counters. Two quick asks from Finance: (1) can we produce a reconciled CSV that maps their columns to our billing tokens (so procurement sees line items), and (2) if we go with the top-up option, we should compute the proration (days remaining in Apr).

Jordan — please add the reconciled breakdown, suggested invoice amount, and a recommended proration approach. If finance signs off, Marissa will approve convert-to-topup or invoice issuance.

Thanks,
Soojin
--
Soojin Lee
Renewals Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudline.ai>; Procurement Team <procurement@cloudline.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2024 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage reconciliation: Mar 2024 retroactive capacity true-up

Hi Samira — thanks for the CSV. I've reconciled Cloudline's export against Redwood usage buckets and included a short breakdown below (line items attached). Summary:

- March committed capacity: 1,210,000 tokens
- March actual billed tokens: 1,352,140 tokens (includes 2 small prefix-cache hits windows we agreed are billable)
- Overrun: 142,140 tokens
- Overage rate per token (contract): $0.04 per 1k tokens => settlement: $5,685.60 USD

Proposal:
1) Convert $3,400 of the charge into a 30-day April top-up (adds 80k tokens to April allocation).
2) Invoice remaining $2,285.60 as a one-time charge.

If that works I'll prepare the invoice and a short MOP summary for procurement. For convenience I've attached: "cloudline_usage_reconcile_Mar2024.csv" (our reconciled sheet) and a draft invoice PDF; DocuSign link for the MOP is here: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ABC-Cloudline-settlement

If you want to proceed with the top-up we just need your PO# and the approver's email; if you'd rather a single invoice, let me know and we'll issue with net-30 terms.

Thanks,
Jordan

Attachments: cloudline_usage_reconcile_Mar2024.csv (CSV, 45KB); redwood_invoice_20240430.pdf (PDF, 12KB)
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudline.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 30 Apr 2024 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage reconciliation: Mar 2024 retroactive capacity true-up

Jordan / Soojin — reviewed the reconciled sheet with Procurement and Finance. We accept the split approach: convert $3,400 into an April top-up and invoice the balance $2,285.60. PO# CL-PO-8842 attached in reply. I've also uploaded the signed MOP to the Drive link and attached a signed copy (cloudline_signed_mop.pdf). Please issue the invoice to procurement@cloudline.ai and cc ethan.park@cloudline.ai.

Next steps for Redwood:
- Finalize invoice PDF with PO# and send to procurement@cloudline.ai (request net-30).
- Apply 80k token top-up to Cloudline April allocation immediately.
- Confirm once invoice sent and top-up applied.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Samira
